title: Check TutorGrantResult before treating revoke/resign/rescind as successful in manage_tutors_screen.dart and manage_grants_screen.dart
why: All three handlers await the use case's Future<TutorGrantResult> and discard the return value, then unconditionally run the success branch (wipe local mirror, invalidate the grant list, send a lifecycle email) inside `if (mounted) { ... }`, with only a generic `catch` around thrown exceptions. FirestoreTutorGrantRepository.revokeGrant/resignGrant/rescindInvite never rethrow FirebaseFunctionsException — they always return TutorGrantFailure. So when the Cloud Function genuinely rejects the call (permission-denied, already-revoked race, offline), the UI still shows success, wipes the tutor's local mirror, and — worst case for _revoke — emails the tutor 'your access was revoked' while the grant is still active server-side, giving the parent false assurance that access was cut off. The sibling screens (invite/accept/decline) all correctly `switch` on the same result type, proving the pattern is known but was missed here.
recommendation: Assign the awaited call to a `result` variable and exhaustively switch on TutorGrantSuccess/TutorGrantFailure/TutorGrantPreconditionError exactly as invite_tutor_screen.dart/accept_invite_screen.dart/decline_invite_screen.dart already do; only run the mirror-wipe/invalidate/notify side effects on Success, and surface a localized error (not e.toString()) otherwise.
acceptance_criteria: Add a widget test in manage_tutors_screen_l1_test.dart that stubs revokeTutorGrantUseCaseProvider/rescindTutorInviteUseCaseProvider to return TutorGrantFailure and asserts wipeMirrorForGrant/notifyTutorOfRevocation/ref.invalidate are NOT invoked and an error is shown.
Add the equivalent test in manage_grants_screen_l1_test.dart for resignTutorGrantUseCaseProvider returning TutorGrantFailure.
flutter analyze clean; existing Success-path tests continue to pass.
